describes: `422` · `VALIDATION_FAILED`. `replaceCart` merges identical lines first, as `addCartLine` does. Two lines that merge to more than 20 are refused, and the cart is unchanged.

error.message: You can add at most 20 of one item.

details.message: Lines 0 and 3 are the same item and add up to 24; the most is 20.
